biography: Dustin is not actively looking to leave his current role but is interested in upward mobility. He is intrigued by the idea of building something new from the ground up, as he understands this company is establishing a presence in the U.S. Dustin anticipates his boss, the VP of Energy, will move into the CDO role within the next one to two years, as the current CDO is expected to retire. He would then be in a position to take on the VP of Energy role, which is his next desired step in progression. Dustin enjoys leading his own team and the success they have achieved. He values the strong team atmosphere, good benefits, and competitive pay. The hybrid work schedule, which includes a balance of remote work, office time, and on-site work, is also a significant positive. Dustin's primary frustration is the lack of knowledge about utility power from others within the company. This often leads to decisions being made without his consultation, resulting in more complex and time-consuming fixes later.
